scope: ring-B consumption, stats upload format, offline 2697 admission and gamestate

engine_drains_ring_b_itself.test: wrote one OOB packet to ring B without calling 0x4F8D70
engine_drains_ring_b_itself.observation: read cursor moved 131 -> 132 within 0.5 s, write cursor matched
engine_drains_ring_b_itself.conclusion: the client frame loop already consumes ring B; external pump calls are unnecessary and were the source of the rendering stalls

flicker_root_cause: per-packet 0x4F8D70 calls suspended/resumed the CODO window thread (tools call path), starving the render loop
the forward retry loop re-armed phase 3 every 8 s while the client bounced back to phase 0, toggling between lobby and loading UI
removing both (no pump, retry disabled) makes the lobby stable; writing [0x76446B0]=0 restores the native lobby immediately

stats_layouts.observed_1649370_single_block: FFFFFFFF 'stats' 00 index=0 compressed=837 + zlib(32768) - only when the profile compresses well
stats_layouts.observed_1649370_multi_block: FFFFFFFF 'stats' 00 index=17 compressed=30722 bytes=528 - the client's block size is not the 1238 bytes the 2697 reader assumes
stats_layouts.profiles: the 1649370 profile header is not crc32(profile[4:]) (observed 0x86AC2088 vs 0xB2BFEF12) and word4/word8 are 233/0x4A6CC345, so the 2697 archive reader rejects it
stats_layouts.bridge_workaround: respond with a synthetic 2697-format upload (25 x 1238 blocks, 32768-byte zero profile with crc32 header and word4=220/word8=0xE4FD5218) and drop the client's own upload

offline_2697_admission.name_encoding: the 2697 archive path requires the 1649370 base64 name (QWRtaW5pc3RyYUNsaWVudA==), not UTF-16LE hex
steps: synthetic stats 25 blocks -> server log 'CoDOL 2697 stats complete client=0 compressed=71'
first clc_move -> 'SV_SendClientGameState()' and 'Going from CS_CONNECTED to CS_PRIMED'
3 gamestate fragments captured (5233 bytes) and reassembled to 3426 bytes

gamestate.layout: 00 00 00 00 | 03 00 00 00 | map NUL | zone NUL | checksum | 04 | configstrings | ... matching the 1649370 initial-state parser

conclusion: The server side of G2 is now proven end-to-end offline: admission, stats completion, CS_PRIMED and a well-formed 1649370-compatible gamestate. The remaining work is client-side: inject the server replies into ring B (the engine drains it itself), send the synthetic stats right after connect, forward clc_move and then inject the gamestate fragments while watching for a real map/world signal.
